def cells(grid):
    """Every nonzero cell as (row, col, value)."""
    return [(i, j, v) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v]

def bbox(cells):
    """The (top, left, bottom, right) bounding box of a list of (row, col, ...) cells."""
    rs = [c[0] for c in cells]; cs = [c[1] for c in cells]
    return min(rs), min(cs), max(rs), max(cs)

def adj(a, b):
    """Whether two (row, col) cells are 8-neighbors."""
    return max(abs(a[0]-b[0]), abs(a[1]-b[1])) == 1

def stamp_at_anchor(grid):
    """Copy the shape so its anchor 5 cell lands on the isolated 5 marker; anchor cell and marker become 0, original kept."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cs = cells(grid)
    fives = [(i, j) for i, j, v in cs if v == 5]
    anchor = marker = None
    for f in fives:
        if any(v != 5 and adj(f, (i, j)) for i, j, v in cs):
            anchor = f
        else:
            marker = f
    shape = [(i, j, v) for i, j, v in cs if (i, j) != marker]
    top, left = min(c[0] for c in shape), min(c[1] for c in shape)
    ar, ac = anchor[0] - top, anchor[1] - left
    dr, dz = marker[0] - (top + ar), marker[1] - (left + ac)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, j, v in shape:
        if (i, j) == anchor:
            v = 0
        r, c = i + dr, j + dz
        if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
            out[r][c] = v
    return out
'''
